verdict.rationale: Thoropass monitors automatically check connected systems such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, refreshing daily or ad hoc. The vendor says it alerts users to compliance violations, and the Monitors page and dashboard flag violations and controls that need attention so they can be investigated. However, no evidence shows these alerts reaching users in Slack, email, or ticketing tools; the documented visibility is in-app only. Missing for 10: documented Slack/email/ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow) alert delivery, configuration-drift-specific alerting, alert payload context/remediation guidance, independent corroboration.
